title: The gunship is the orbital strike's platform: a mount on a fixed orbital pass, gunner only, soft-warning collateral
context: Owner asked to start planning two things: Heavy Gunship mechanics, and alternatives to half-dotted enemies. The orbital strike in src/strike.js works and is satisfying but has no home — no fiction, no body, no seat — while the module already implies a platform that must re-enter orbit. The KORP/GS01 heavy gunship exists as a pinned-able asset at SentryTowers_A6/korp with rotary cannons, a heavy cannon and engine-tilt clips. Owner's brief: 25mm rotary, 40mm Bofors, 105mm M102; perspective shift, thermal imaging, herding into heavier fire; avoid friendlies and avoid opening your own walls; tension and thematic weight over a decoded-language gap.
outcome: Design agreed in docs/superpowers/specs/2026-09-13-heavy-gunship-design.md; nothing implemented. GUNSHIP becomes a mount on the existing strip, gunner only — the player never flies it. The diegetic limit is fuel: the gunship is in orbit and cannot manoeuvre or land, so it passes over the base on a fixed schedule the player cannot influence; overhead the guns are live, otherwise the next pass counts down. No fuel meter ships; fuel becomes spendable only if the later VTOL landing progression arrives. One airframe yields two resources: the 105mm IS the orbital strike, rationed by strike.js unchanged and conserved for sinkholes, while the 25mm and 40mm are free while on station. Collateral is soft warning only: per-gun danger rings are readouts, never refusals, and breakWalls/breakTowers stay true, so the player can open their own base. The view is a thermal optic with the real render in the corner monitor, reusing src/fx/story-monitor.js and src/fx/story-scope.js unchanged. New code lands in src/domain/gunship.js, src/content/gunship.js and src/fx/gunship-optic.js with sentry-pilot.js as the only host; strike.js is not modified and td-tab.js does not grow.
alternatives: Player flies and guns the aircraft: rejected, the fuel fiction makes the gunner-only limit diegetic and it avoids a flight model, chase camera and new input host.

Gunship as a dedicated escort mission only: rejected for the first spec, because the orbital strike would still have no home in normal play. The resupply mission is deferred to its own spec, written after the guns have been held.
Per-gun hard standoff refusing shots near friendlies: rejected by the owner in favour of soft warning; the refusal would remove the tension and turn collateral into a UI state.
Hard lockout on all guns: rejected for the same reason.
Thermal as the only view, or as a toggle over the normal render: rejected in favour of the split, so the player aims in abstraction and sees the consequence in ground truth.
Fuel as a spendable meter now: rejected, it would stack a second rationing economy on top of strike.js before the VTOL unlock gives spending a meaning.
evidence: src/strike.js already rations and re-orbits an unnamed platform and defaults breakWalls/breakTowers true, so friendly fire and wall destruction are existing tested behaviour, not new mechanics.
src/fx/story-monitor.js (29 lines) already renders a scissored second camera and has an optic mode framing a target through a long lens; src/fx/story-scope.js (47 lines) is host-fed once a frame.

https://jelaludo.github.io/SentryTowers_A6/korp/ retrieved 2026-09-13: KORP/GS01 heavy gunship, MÖRK family, LOD1/GameLOD0/LOD2, forward/hover/landed poses, rotary and heavy cannon and engine-tilt clips.

docs/STATE.md records the inherited formula reaching 5,334 scheduled bodies at wave 75; enemies are Points clouds in src/creatures.js and src/units.js, so horde scale is an unverified assumption recorded in the spec.
